question: What is the one-word substitute for "a person who questions or rejects generally accepted opinions or beliefs"?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Iconoclast**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Iconoclast"** refers to a person who challenges or rejects traditional beliefs, customs, or institutions. (परंपरागत मान्यताओं, प्रथाओं, या संस्थाओं को चुनौती देने या अस्वीकार करने वाला व्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example:** The artist was an iconoclast who refused to conform to the conventional rules of painting.
 
 
• **Iconoclast** is the most suitable one-word substitute for "a person who questions or rejects generally accepted opinions or beliefs."
 
 
• **Example:** The iconoclast questioned the long-standing traditions of the society, urging for progressive changes.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Iconoclast**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Heretic** (विधर्मिक): A person who holds controversial opinions or beliefs that are in conflict with the accepted doctrine, especially in religion.
 
 
• **Example:** During the medieval period, heretics were often persecuted for their beliefs.
 
 

 
• **Dissenter** (असंतुष्ट): Someone who disagrees or refuses to conform to an established idea, policy, or authority.
 
 
• **Example:** The dissenter voiced his opposition to the new corporate policies during the meeting.
 
 

 
• **Apostate** (धर्मत्यागी): A person who renounces a religious or political belief or principle.
 
 
• **Example:** The apostate faced criticism for abandoning his faith and joining a new ideology.
 
 

3f:Tede,
The correct answer is **Option 4**.
